# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_VWAP_REVERSAL_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A gap up that opens above VWAP but fails to hold often reverses to fill the gap, providing a short opportunity. This fade strategy targets the mean reversion after an initial gap up fails to attract sustained buying pressure, particularly when the open is above VWAP but price crosses below VWAP early in the session with confirming volume.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: Today's open > prior day's close + 0.3% (gap up) AND open price > VWAP(5‑min) AND price crosses below VWAP within the first 30 min AND volume on the down‑cross bar > 1.5× average volume of the prior 5 bars  
Exit shape: Stop at the high of the gap bar, target at prior day's close (gap fill) or 1R, runner trail using a chandelier exit (ATR‑based)  
Regime hint: VIX > 18, time between 09:30‑10:30 EST, and absence of a new higher high on the 15‑min chart in the first 30 min (no strong trend)
